method: Read actual diffs, complete changed modules/tests, constructor and caller context; no sources/tests changed and no test reruns.
classification: Narrow fail-closed hardening and offline operator mistake prevention. No public exploit or production qualification is claimed.

reviews.evidence: validate normalizes all planned/input addresses first; seen excludes None and includes every known planned top-level protocol contract. Existing Access collision diagnostic remains first. Fixed native dependencies and SeaDrop reject as governance without reading build/RPC. Partial and case-mixed collisions reject. Unknown wallet and shared human governance/keeper/guardian/recipient remain allowed. Existing output-preservation and source/build gates are unchanged.
reviews.test_review: Six new methods cover every other TOP role, every known external dependency, Access diagnostic, mixed case/partial plan, legitimate shared human roles/template, and CLI refusal before Artifacts/output. Reviewed source, not rerun.

reviews.evidence: lstat distinguishes a present dangling leaf link from a missing entry; only FileNotFoundError during initial lstat returns the supplied default. PermissionError/EIO propagate, as do read failures after a successful presence observation. Existing duplicate-key/nonfinite/malformed JSON parser and atomic writes are unchanged. Readable symlink configuration remains accepted.
reviews.test_review: Seven new methods cover modeled dangling link, permission/EIO, disappear-after-lstat, actual absence/default identity/no file creation, actual dangling symlink, and readable config symlink. Actual link tests explicitly skip Windows privilege error1314 only. Reviewed source, not rerun.

reviews.evidence: Constructor rejects schema4/source9, schema5/source10 and unknown/non-number schemas before signer construction, provider listeners, API preparation or RPC. Exact numeric schemas1/2/3 retain historical local coordinator capability; independent rehearsal/chain31337/http127.0.0.1 origin/RPC checks remain. Real DeploymentAPI clones and deeply freezes its validated manifest. Shared BrowserWallet remains unmodified and Anvil-only; current source9/source10 are unsigned.
reviews.test_review: Five new tests include two validator-accepted fresh fixtures, unknown/missing/wrongly typed schemas, actual BrowserWallet construction/listener teardown for three historical schemas without sends, and independent network/origin rejection. Maintained package test list includes new file. Reviewed source, not rerun.

limitations: These changes prevent known invalid inputs/state interpretations; they do not authenticate a usable EOA/Safe/delegated governance wallet or discover unknown constructor-created child addresses. Live authority qualification remains separate.

The lstat check does not provide an atomic filesystem read/write transaction, reject every ancestor symlink, defeat a hostile privileged filesystem owner, or change atomic_json behavior. No such guarantee should be claimed.
The local signing constructor accepts only historical schemas1-3. This is capability narrowing, not fresh-profile browser-wallet or live public signing qualification.
No claim is made about focused test execution results; the implementing agents/root own execution evidence. Hash changes after this capture require renewed review of those differences.
